name: Send a weekly YouTube channel digest to Slack with Arcmira and Claude

parameters.text:
=Summarize this YouTube video for a busy reader in 3 to 5 points.
Write each point as one line: the timestamp, one short sentence on the point, then a quote in quotation marks.
Example: - [12:34] They are moving the build to a new region. "We moved everything to the new region last month, and the build is twice as fast."
The quote is the whole sentence that makes the point, copied word for word from the transcript. Transcript lines break mid-sentence, so join neighbouring lines until the quote starts and ends at a sentence boundary. Keep each quote under 300 characters.
The timestamp is the one on the line where the point is made, exactly as written in the transcript.
Use only the transcript. If a line names its speaker, say who said it.
End with one line that starts "Watch if:" and says who should watch the whole video. Plain text only, no Markdown.

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Channel: {{ $json.channel }}

Transcript:
{{ $json.transcript }}

parameters.content:
### How it works
Every Monday Claude summarizes your channels' new videos.

### Setup
On the Free plan this digest runs 30 days behind, because the Free plan withholds the newest 30 days of media. A paid plan or the Pro trial reads last week's videos.
Get a key at https://arcmira.com/sign-up?src=n8n-weekly-channel-digest&utm_source=n8n&utm_campaign=n8n-weekly-channel-digest, then follow notes 1 to 4.

### What Arcmira returns
Arcmira returns the exact quote and a watch link cued to the second, so the reader can check the source. This template makes three calls:
- `GET /v1/me`: the newest date your plan reads (`freshness`). It uses no credits.
- `GET /v1/channels/{channel_id}/videos`: a channel's indexed videos, newest first.
- `GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=captions&timestamps=true`: the transcript as timed `lines`.

A listed video uses 4 credits from your plan, and the first 5 in each request are free. A caption transcript uses 4 credits per started 15 minutes.

### Build this with your agent
```
Use Arcmira (the arcmira MCP server, or its API with my key). Every Monday, post a Slack digest of new videos on my YouTube channels UC_CHANNEL_ID_1 and UC_CHANNEL_ID_2.
1. Call arcmira.status() (GET /v1/me) first. List each channel's videos from the 7 days that ended 2 days ago (GET /v1/channels/{channel_id}/videos). If status() reports freshness, list the 7 days that end on its served_through instead, and say where results stop.
2. Read each video's transcript (GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=captions&timestamps=true).
3. Read each whole transcript, then write 3 to 5 points per video, each quoting a whole sentence word for word.
4. Post each video's title from the list, its channel and points. Link each quote to the start of the line that holds its first word, with the transcript's video.watch_url plus &t={start}s, in whole seconds.
Check it worked: run it once now and show me the digest before you schedule it.
```

### 1. When and what
Runs every Monday at 8:00. In **Settings**, paste your channel ids (`UC...`), comma separated. `days` (7) is how many days the digest covers, and `wait_days` (2) is how many of the newest days it leaves for next week, so Arcmira has indexed them.

### 2. New videos from Arcmira
`GET /v1/channels/{channel_id}/videos` lists each channel's indexed videos in the window. The loop asks for one channel at a time, so each call gets its own 5 tries. A channel Arcmira doesn't index comes back empty, and the digest names it. A week with nothing new posts nothing. On the Free plan, `GET /v1/me` in **Check the plan's dates** names the newest date the plan reads (`freshness.served_through`). It uses no credits. The run then lists the 7 days that end on that date, and the digest opens with Arcmira's note and its unlock link.

Pick a **Header Auth** credential here and in note 3: `Authorization`, `Bearer <your key>`.

### 3. Transcripts and summary
`GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=captions&timestamps=true` returns timed lines. The loop reads one transcript at a time, so each call gets its own 5 tries. Claude writes 3 to 5 points per video, each with a whole quoted sentence and the time it was said.

Connect Anthropic in **Claude**.

### 4. Send
One Slack digest. Each time opens the video at that second. Videos with no transcript are named at the end.

Connect Slack in **Post to Slack** and set the channel id.
